post.title: Photo booths want a monthly fee. Open Photo Booth is free.
post.caption: Three fresh grudges: photo booth software billed by the month, phone mirroring that somehow needs a subscription, and meeting note-takers that rent out your own calls.

segments.gripe: Photo booth software, billed monthly to print a strip of four.
segments.quote: Most photo booth software is sold as a monthly subscription

cues.cap: is sold as a monthly subscription…”
cues.say: is sold as a monthly subscription.

segments.gripe: Mirroring your own phone to your own PC, for a fee.
segments.quote: I built a free app to mirror your iPhone to Windows because I was tired of paying for it

cues.cap: to mirror your iPhone to Windows
because I was tired of paying for it”
cues.say: because I was tired of paying for it.

cues.cap: So: Mirlow. No app on the phone.
cues.say: [quick] So: Meer-low. No app on the phone.

segments.gripe: Meeting note-takers, billed by the month.
segments.quote: There are tools for this, but most charge by the month

cues.cap: but most charge by the month…”
cues.say: but most charge by the month.

cues.cap: So: MeetCap. Transcribes on your Mac.
cues.say: [quick] So: Meet Cap. Transcribes on your Mac.

cues.cap: All built out of pure spite.
